reserves.name: USDC-denominated institutional loans and supporting strategies

reserveReview.rationale: Maple documents an ERC-4626 claim on a segregated USDC-denominated pool whose assets include overcollateralized institutional loans and supporting basis/liquidity strategies. Withdrawal queues can take up to 30 days, so the reserve is classified as private credit with an over-seven-day liquidity horizon.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Maple pool structure and proof-of-reserves disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unlinked reserve exposure is recorded; borrower, collateral, and supporting-strategy allocations vary within the linked USDC-denominated pool and are not stored as fixed weights.

sources.label: Maple custody and legal structure FAQ

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Maple identifies approved institutional custodians and a segregated SPV, but collateral is allocated across custodians and may be staked under strategy controls. Provider-level shares and the live borrower/collateral allocation are not published in the static review.
